E1.label: ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REDUCTION
E1.summary: The project strategy includes at least one action to reduce environmental impact.
E1.description: The project strategy includes at least one action to reduce environmental impact.
E1.whyItMatters: Actions lead to designs with a lower impact.

E2.label: LIFECYCLE
E2.summary: The project’s strategy is supported by a qualified, simplified life cycle study (LCS) or quantitative life cycle assessment (LCA).
E2.description: The project’s strategy is supported by a qualified, simplified life cycle study (LCS) or quantitative life cycle assessment (LCA).
E2.whyItMatters: Design addresses the environmental impact of a product.

E3.label: PRODUCT INGREDIENTS LIST
E3.summary: The product or product packaging includes a list of components and/or ingredients.
E3.description: The product or product packaging includes a list of components and/or ingredients.
E3.whyItMatters: The display of “ingredients” or material components.

E4.label: INK, PRINTING, AND FINISHES
E4.summary: The project materials were designed to reduce or eliminate the use of inks, varnishes and finishes or requires no printing.
E4.description: The project materials were designed to reduce or eliminate the use of inks, varnishes and finishes or requires no printing.
E4.whyItMatters: Reduces ink coverage on printed materials.

E5.label: PAPER
E5.summary: The project materials were designed to reduce paper.
E5.description: The project materials were designed to reduce paper.
E5.whyItMatters: Efficient use of paper and reduces paper use.

E6.label: PRODUCT QUANTITY
E6.summary: No more units than needed were produced, including the possibility of no physical copies at all.
E6.description: No more units than needed were produced, including the possibility of no physical copies at all.

E7.label: EXTENDED LIFE PRODUCT
E7.summary: When a longer lifetime is desirable for a product or system, it is designed to be reused, recharged, repaired, and/or upgraded as an environmental benefit.
E7.description: When a longer lifetime is desirable for a product or system, it is designed to be reused, recharged, repaired, and/or upgraded as an environmental benefit.
E7.whyItMatters: Product design for longer life than the industry average.

E7b.label: DURABILITY
E7b.summary: The product or system is physically durable.
E7b.description: The product or system is physically durable.
E7b.whyItMatters: Physical durability as a product asset, where applicable.

E9.label: TOXINS
E9.summary: The project reduces or eliminates the use of toxins.
E9.description: The project reduces or eliminates the use of toxins.
E9.whyItMatters: Reduces or eliminates toxins in a product.

E10.label: ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY
E10.summary: The designing entity and a majority of suppliers have a publicly-accessible environmental policy.
E10.description: The designing entity and a majority of suppliers have a publicly-accessible environmental policy.

E11.label: QUANTIFIED REPORTING
E11.summary: The designing entity has published a quantified report of reductions in GHG emissions and/or energy, material usage and waste disposal.
E11.description: The designing entity has published a quantified report of reductions in GHG emissions and/or energy, material usage and waste disposal.
E11.whyItMatters: Publicly-accessible reporting of materials, waste and emissions.

EM4.label: ANIMAL WELFARE
EM4.summary: The success of the project does not and will not put animals or entire animal of an ecosystem at risk.
EM4.description: The success of the project does not and will not put animals or entire animal of an ecosystem at risk.
EM4.whyItMatters: Animals are not at risk from this project.

EM6.label: ECOSYSTEMS CONSERVATION
EM6.summary: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the client’s activities and the project do not depend on, or support the destruction of fragile ecosystems.
EM6.description: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the client’s activities and the project do not depend on, or support the destruction of fragile ecosystems.

E15.label: PRODUCT’S END OF LIFE
E15.summary: The product is locally compostable by the end user or can be incorporated into a local energy-recovery system that does not involve landfill or thermal treatment.
E15.description: The product is locally compostable by the end user or can be incorporated into a local energy-recovery system that does not involve landfill or thermal treatment.
E15.whyItMatters: The product can be composted or used as fuel or food.

E14.label: RECYCLABILITY OR REUSABILITY
E14.summary: Design solutions include materials or systems that increase the ease and likelihood of recycling and/or reuse of the product and/or its packaging.
E14.description: Design solutions include materials or systems that increase the ease and likelihood of recycling and/or reuse of the product and/or its packaging.
E14.whyItMatters: Product and packaging can be reused or recycled.

E13.label: ZERO WASTE
E13.summary: The final product is a “zero waste” product.
E13.description: The final product is a “zero waste” product.

E16.label: RENEWABLE ENERGY
E16.summary: The production of the product uses renewable energy from solar, wind, thermal or tidal sources.
E16.description: The production of the product uses renewable energy from solar, wind, thermal or tidal sources.
E16.whyItMatters: Clean energy sources were used to make the product.

E17.label: NON-RENEWABLE RESOURCES
E17.summary: The project reduces or eliminates the use of scarce, non-renewable natural resources and raw materials.
E17.description: The project reduces or eliminates the use of scarce, non-renewable natural resources and raw materials.
E17.whyItMatters: Strategies reduce the use of non-renewable natural resources.

E18.label: CONSUMER ENERGY
E18.summary: The product or system used by the consumer is energy efficient or uses renewable energy.
E18.description: The product or system used by the consumer is energy efficient or uses renewable energy.

E19.label: TRANSPORT
E19.summary: The project strategy includes shipping and/or warehousing efficiencies to reduce transportation and waste.
E19.description: The project strategy includes shipping and/or warehousing efficiencies to reduce transportation and waste.

E20.label: CO2 CERTIFICATION
E20.summary: The design entity or the product displays a recognized certification or third party declaration of the product’s CO2 emissions.
E20.description: The design entity or the product displays a recognized certification or third party declaration of the product’s CO2 emissions.
E20.whyItMatters: A certified third party declares CO2 emissions.

E21.label: AIR POLLUTION AND GREENHOUSE GASES
E21.summary: Air pollution or greenhouse gas emissions were avoided or reduced, mitigating ocean acidification.
E21.description: Air pollution or greenhouse gas emissions were avoided or reduced, mitigating ocean acidification.

E22.label: CARBON OFFSETS
E22.summary: The design entity or project offsets CO2 emissions for travel, production and Web presence.
E22.description: The design entity or project offsets CO2 emissions for travel, production and Web presence.
E22.whyItMatters: Carbon credits offset travel, production and Web presence.

E23.label: WATER
E23.summary: Water pollution or water use were avoided or reduced.
E23.description: Water pollution or water use were avoided or reduced.

S1.label: HARMLESS
S1.summary: The project is purposely designed to reduce mental and physical injury to those who produce or use the product.
S1.description: The project is purposely designed to reduce mental and physical injury to those who produce or use the product.
S1.whyItMatters: Reduces injury in the making and use of the product.

S2.label: HEALTH AND SAFETY
S2.summary: The project’s main focus is to improve the health or safety of the target audience.
S2.description: The project’s main focus is to improve the health or safety of the target audience.

S3.label: LOCAL LABOUR
S3.summary: Design and production significantly increased the amount of locally sourced labour from the end user’s location.
S3.description: Design and production significantly increased the amount of locally sourced labour from the end user’s location.

SM1.label: HUMAN RIGHTS
SM1.summary: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the project and the client do not contribute directly or indirectly to the violation of universal human rights.
SM1.description: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the project and the client do not contribute directly or indirectly to the violation of universal human rights.
SM1.whyItMatters: Design does not contribute to the violation of human rights.

SM2.label: CORRUPTION
SM2.summary: To the best knowledge of the design entity, no corruption was involved in the project.
SM2.description: To the best knowledge of the design entity, no corruption was involved in the project.
SM2.whyItMatters: Corruption was not identified in the project.

SM3.label: RIGHTS OF WORKERS
SM3.summary: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the project and the client do not contribute directly or indirectly to the violation of the fundamental principles and rights of workers.
SM3.description: To the best knowledge of the design entity, the project and the client do not contribute directly or indirectly to the violation of the fundamental principles and rights of workers.

S10.label: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI)
S10.summary: The process of the design production is human made and, if AI was used to create the design, it is clearly labelled. The AI used is from ethical data sourcing, compliant with transparency, from ethical databases, and free from bias.
S10.description: The process of the design production is human made and, if AI was used to create the design, it is clearly labelled. The AI used is from ethical data sourcing, compliant with transparency, from ethical databases, and free from bias.
S10.whyItMatters: Authentically created design by a person.

S6.label: ELECTRONIC DOCUMENTS
S6.summary: All electronic documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level A standard or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA accessibility standard.
S6.description: All electronic documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level A standard or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA accessibility standard.
S6.whyItMatters: Accessibility of all electronic documents, including Web pages.

S6b.label: DOCUMENTS AND COMPLIANCE
S6b.summary: All documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level AA standard or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA, formally ISO 14289 accessibility standard.
S6b.description: All documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level AA standard or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA, formally ISO 14289 accessibility standard.

S8.label: UNIVERSAL DESIGN PRINCIPLES
S8.summary: The non-document components of the project adhere to universal design principles.
S8.description: The non-document components of the project adhere to universal design principles.

S9.label: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
S9.summary: The process or product shares reusable intellectual property that may be considered valuable to society as a whole.
S9.description: The process or product shares reusable intellectual property that may be considered valuable to society as a whole.
S9.whyItMatters: Design with open content that is freely available for use, adaptation, and distribution under specific conditions set by the creator.

S11.label: AFFORDABLE
S11.summary: The product is affordable to a wide audience including those with limited financial resources.
S11.description: The product is affordable to a wide audience including those with limited financial resources.
S11.whyItMatters: Sustainable products are affordable for all market sectors.

S12.label: FAIR TRADE
S12.whyItMatters: Collaborations between low, middle and high income countries.

S13.label: SOCIAL GAPS
S13.summary: The project’s main focus aims to close gaps of gender, power, or wealth.
S13.description: The project’s main focus aims to close gaps of gender, power, or wealth.
S13.whyItMatters: Reduces wealth and power gaps inside and between countries.

S14.label: FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION
S14.summary: The project’s main focus encourages or educates about democracy and/or freedom of expression.
S14.description: The project’s main focus encourages or educates about democracy and/or freedom of expression.
S14.whyItMatters: Encourages freedom of expression and/or democracy.

S15.label: DESIGN EDUCATION
S15.summary: The project includes design students and/or enriches existing design school curriculum.
S15.description: The project includes design students and/or enriches existing design school curriculum.
S15.whyItMatters: Provides design education opportunities for students.

S16.label: EDUCATIONAL COMPONENT
S16.summary: The product includes an educational component that promotes sustainability to the consumer.
S16.description: The product includes an educational component that promotes sustainability to the consumer.
S16.whyItMatters: Educates the user or consumer on sustainability.

C2.label: ENDANGERED LANGUAGES
C2.summary: The project is likely to help preserve endangered languages, particularly Indigenous languages.
C2.description: The project is likely to help preserve endangered languages, particularly Indigenous languages.
C2.whyItMatters: Contributes to the preservation of endangered languages.

C3.label: INDIGENOUS CULTURE
C3.summary: The project preserves or nurtures Indigenous culture, other than language.
C3.description: The project preserves or nurtures Indigenous culture, other than language.

C4.label: LOCAL CULTURE
C4.summary: The project’s products or services adapt to local and regional cultures.
C4.description: The project’s products or services adapt to local and regional cultures.

C5.label: CULTURAL DIVERSITY
C5.summary: The project intends to promote or enhance cultural diversity.
C5.description: The project intends to promote or enhance cultural diversity.
C5.whyItMatters: Design promotes or enhances cultural diversity.

CM9.label: CULTURAL POLICY
CM9.summary: The designing entity and the majority of suppliers have a publicly-accessible policy to actively protect and support communities.
CM9.description: The designing entity and the majority of suppliers have a publicly-accessible policy to actively protect and support communities.

C6.label: AUDIENCE PARTICIPATION
C6.summary: The project includes participation by direct audience members or end users throughout the design process.
C6.description: The project includes participation by direct audience members or end users throughout the design process.
C6.whyItMatters: Design process engages with end user.

C7.label: COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
C7.summary: The project’s designing entity actively supports and participates in the sustainable development of their community.
C7.description: The project’s designing entity actively supports and participates in the sustainable development of their community.
C7.whyItMatters: Actively supports the sustainable development of your community.

C8.label: PRACTITIONERS’ EDUCATION
C8.summary: The project results in the education of practitioners regarding sustainable design.
C8.description: The project results in the education of practitioners regarding sustainable design.
C8.whyItMatters: Project educates others to support sustainable design education.

F1.label: ECONOMIC BENEFITS
F1.summary: The project strategy identifies and creates economic benefits outside the client and the designing entity.
F1.description: The project strategy identifies and creates economic benefits outside the client and the designing entity.
F1.whyItMatters: Adds value to benefit a region’s economy.

F2.label: PROFITABILITY
F2.summary: The project budget or contract does not assume financial loss by the designing entity.
F2.description: The project budget or contract does not assume financial loss by the designing entity.
F2.whyItMatters: The designing entity profits from the project.

FM3.label: UNPAID WORK
FM3.summary: There was no process by the design entity or in the project where designers, including student designers, were asked to provide unpaid work, also known as free pitching or speculative work.
FM3.description: There was no process by the design entity or in the project where designers, including student designers, were asked to provide unpaid work, also known as free pitching or speculative work.
FM3.whyItMatters: All design work is financially compensated.

F4.label: SMART GOALS
F4.summary: A strategy document exists that includes measurable financial objectives.
F4.description: A strategy document exists that includes measurable financial objectives.
F4.whyItMatters: Financial objectives are defined in a design brief.

F5.label: ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY
F5.summary: The designing entity and the client adhere to accountable and transparent processes and procedures.
F5.description: The designing entity and the client adhere to accountable and transparent processes and procedures.

F6.label: STANDARDS IMPROVEMENT
F6.summary: The project resulted in improvements to the designing entity’s documented standard procedures.
F6.description: The project resulted in improvements to the designing entity’s documented standard procedures.
F6.whyItMatters: Continuous improvement in the designing entity’s organization.

F7.label: DESIGN THINKING
F7.summary: Design thinking adds financial value to the audience, users, and/or stakeholders.
F7.description: Design thinking adds financial value to the audience, users, and/or stakeholders.
F7.whyItMatters: Adds value to a business through design strategy.
